_note: The Overgrowth, level 14: a jungle of titans. See docs/zones.md.

overgrowth.name: the Overgrowth
overgrowth.description: A jungle grown to the size of mountains, and the beasts that grew with it.

og_landing.name: The Ripple
og_landing.description: A ripple in the air between two trunks. Through it, grey mould and the Rotwood.

og_camp.name: Canopy Camp
og_camp.description: A camp on a branch as wide as a road, a hundred feet up. Annick Vos's maps everywhere.

og_ferns.name: The Fern Sea
og_ferns.description: Ferns as tall as houses. Things purr in them.

og_river.name: The Wide River
og_river.description: A brown river a mile wide, with trees floating in it like twigs.

og_mantis.name: The Mantis Hollow
og_mantis.description: A hollow lined with husks. Something green and patient waits in it.

og_path.name: The Titan's Path
og_path.description: A road smashed flat through the jungle by something enormous. It's still here.

og_ford.name: The Titan Ford
og_ford.description: A ford where the titans drink. The ground shakes.

og_overlook.name: The Overlook
og_overlook.description: A rock above the canopy. From here you can see the whole green world.

annick.name: Annick Vos
annick.label: Explorer
annick.description: a sunburned explorer with a sextant and a machete
annick.details: A sunburned explorer with a sextant and a machete.

topics.work: Ask me about the chart, or the mantis.

chart.text: I'm charting the Green. I need eyes at three places: the Wide River, the Titan Ford, and the Overlook. Go there. Don't wake the Thunderhorns: they're not hostile, they just don't notice what they step on.

mantis.text: The Mantis Queen ate my last guide. She's in the hollow past the river. Block the scythes, dodge the lunge.

heart-ripple.depart: You step through the ripple out of the spores and into a wall of green.

river.goal: Reach the Wide River, past the Fern Sea.

ford.goal: Reach the Titan Ford. Creep past the Thunderhorns.
